manual_inputs.note: Triple-click SourceBox to select OxFormsDragSeed; drag (press -> stepped move -> release) onto TargetBox with gVetoDrop False -> the drop inserts.

manual_inputs.note: Same drag with gVetoDrop True -> TargetBox_BeforeDropOrPaste sets Cancel=True; the target drop is suppressed.
